name: Shōwa (Gunma, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Shōwa village emblem in white: a stylised angular device of two characters above a fan shape.
history: Municipal flag of Shōwa, a village in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 November 1970.

features.role: Shōwa village emblem — a stylised angular device of two characters above a fan shape
